The '''Ubooki brothers''' were a litter of [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bimm/Legends|Bimms]] from [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]]. At least eighteen of them perpetuated the "[[Glah Ubooki (alias)|Glah Ubooki]]" myth and ran [[Glah Ubooki's Strange & Wondrous Imports|shops]] on multiple [[Planet/Legends|planets]] including Bimmisaari, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
